blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senator-judge Raffy Tulfo urges the impeachment court to issue warning to court spokesperson lawyer Reginald Tongol, accusing him of repeatedly making statements that could be seen as prejudging the case. “Maraming beses na siyang sumablay, pumalpak, paulit-ulit na lang,” Tulfo said during Day 33 of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. /dp READ: LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Oct. 5, 2026...
